title: Two Recursions for the Seiberg-Witten Prepotential: Zamolodchikov's Recursion, the AGT Correspondence and Topological Recursion on the Seiberg-Witten Curve
summary: The Seiberg-Witten prepotential of four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ gauge theory can be reached by two recursions of very different nature, and this thesis compares them explicitly. The first part is a self-contained review of the microscopic side: the ADHM construction as a hyperkähler quotient, the supersymmetric measure on the instanton moduli space, Seiberg-Witten theory, and the one- and two-instanton contributions computed by non-commutative resolution and localisation.
